Hi,
I was wondering if there have been papers about seeing if an AI with formalization can rediscover existing math and in so doing come up with alternate proofs of existing theorems? Like for example giving the AI the proof of epsilon conjecture and other info about modular forms, then having it try to prove fermat's last theorem? I feel like it would be fairly revealing as to how the AI thinks.

Because it has already seen it , it’s not so useful. It’s like if you use your training data to see how well the model works in a way. I would suggest trying out the AI with some Lean, it isn’t too mysterious how it thinks once you do this enough.

I would also not say it “thinks” anymore than any other algorithm really, just less explainable .
